description: The framework screen's signature hero: a circular progress ring whose stroke is the current level's token color, the level number centered, and the level name + percent complete below. The only card on the screen that floats (glassFloating).

level.description: Current framework level 1-5. When null, renders the empty/onboarding variant.

levelName.description: Level display name, e.g. 'Build Security'. Falls back to LEVEL_NAMES[level-1].

completedPct.description: Percent complete toward the next level, 0-100. Drives the ring sweep and the caption.

loading.description: Renders the skeleton hero (circle + two text-line skeletons).

onGetStarted.description: CTA handler for the empty/onboarding variant.

accessibility.label: Level {level}, {levelName}, {completedPct} percent complete toward the next level.
accessibility.emptyLabel: Your CoupleFlow journey hasn't started yet. Add your income, debts, and savings to see your level.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Level identity conveyed by ring fill + number + name + 'LEVEL' label together, never color alone.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Ring renders at final stroke offset with no animated sweep.
